description: This PHP class 'DetailedTimesheetModel' is part of the OrangeHRM project and represents a data model for detailed timesheets, including serialization logic for API responses. It utilizes traits for date/time helpers and normalization, and formats detailed timesheet data into an array structure suitable for output.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes DetailedTimesheet data for API responses, encapsulating project, customer, activity, total time, and date-specific entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a DetailedTimesheet object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the detailed timesheet data into an array suitable for JSON serialization, including nested project, customer, activity, total time, and date details.
